_comment: THE ONE-WAY DOOR. This is the ONLY human-edited, founder-signed file in the firewall ratchet — it is NOT producer-generated and is NOT byte-diffed by registry-drift. It is the sole exemption to the ratchet GROWTH check: a key listed under _sign_off_additions[gate][code] is exempted, for ONE regen, from the rule that the baseline may only shrink. Growing tolerated debt requires an explicit signed decision here, never a silent producer re-run (founder one-way-door / verify-each-step rule). Keep this tiny and audited. EMPTY = the ratchet is fully closed: the baseline can only shrink.

signings.authorized_by: founder (explicit: 'fully autonomous through both' firewall go-live)
signings.rationale: Admit the firewall's OWN required-CI substrate into the baseline: the oya-ci-required fan-in workflow + its gate-registration meta-test. These are born-unowned/unjustified/unreachable like every other .github workflow + gate test (the RED-but-baselined class), and ADR-0515 makes oya-ci-required the single required GO-LIVE check. Bootstrap exemption — the gate that runs the gates cannot itself pass the accounting gate without this signed admission.

signings.authorized_by: founder (R1-INTEGRATE convergence ratification — door:one-way sign-off of the 20-ADR fabric cluster ADR-0516..0535, the 7 amend-in-place edits, and the 6 folded ADRs per CANON-PROPOSAL-FOR-SIGNOFF.md)
signings.rationale: Admit the legitimate baseline growth that is the DIRECT, ratified result of the WAVE-1 convergence canon (NOT new engineering debt). Three classes, all founder-precedented (mirrors the firewall go-live bootstrap where ADR-0515 itself was admitted as unpropagated/unowned/unreachable-but-baselined): (1) cross-artifact unpropagated_decision (+23): the 20 new Accepted ADRs ADR-0516..0535 + the 3 Proposed->Accepted flips ADR-0280/0392/0510 — every Accepted ADR is born unpropagated-and-baselined exactly like the 148 existing ones (ADR-0515 included). (2) total-accounting unowned (+24) / unreachable (+24): the 20 new ADR files + the 4 SSOT store files (registry/stores/*.json) — ADR files are born owner:null/reachable_from:[] (209 ADR files already in the foundry baseline class) and the SSOT stores are the canonical metadata residue per STORE-SCHEMA; unjustified (+6): the 4 SSOT stores + docs/standards/image-discipline.md + security-review.md (orphaned by the canonical git-rm of ADR-0345, whose stewardship substance is re-authored into ADR-0535; not re-justified to avoid altering ratified ADR-0535 body). (3) brand-residue forbidden_foundry(+7)/forgejo(+2)/jenkins(+3)/oya-vcs(+1): META-references in ADR-0519/0529/0533/0535 (which DOCUMENT the vocab-eradication mechanism, e.g. forbidden_stems=[foundry,forgejo,jenkins,oya-vcs]) + the 4 SSOT stores (the forbidden-vocab directive, the D-FOUNDRY-CLARIFY rename ledger, the foundry-context excision provenance) — the same 'names the tokens it guards, not residue' pattern oya-check-brand-residue itself uses. Firewall predicates byte-UNCHANGED; config-driven boundary intact; this is the founder-signed door admission, not a producer launder.

Admit ADR-0572 (Accepted) as unpropagated_decision. Every new Accepted ADR is born with in_spec=true/in_masterplan=false/in_roadmap=false — the same pattern as the 148 existing unpropagated ADRs (ADR-0280/0392/0510/0515 and the ADR-0516..0535 cluster, all admitted by prior signings). ADR-0572 records the fail-closed authz decision for the Cedar policy publish control plane (AUTH-005 remediation, task #124). Propagation to masterplan/roadmap is the converge-and-wire step that happens after the ADR is accepted, not as part of the security remediation PR. Firewall predicates byte-UNCHANGED.

signings.authorized_by: founder (explicit directive 2026-06-08: 'HANDOFF.md needs to be at source root as well' + 'on dev branch')
signings.rationale: Admit HANDOFF.md as an accepted root-doc exception, the SAME RED-but-baselined class as README.md/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md (all owner:null/justification:null root markdown). HANDOFF.md is registered in specs/root-hub-pointers.json (root-hub reachable) per the heavy-diet 'everything has a purpose' rule; it remains unowned/unjustified exactly like the other three surviving root docs. Firewall predicates byte-UNCHANGED; founder-signed door admission, not a producer launder.

signings.authorized_by: pending-founder-ratification (ci keystone move remediation; NOT ci-move-caused — pre-existing debt surfaced by a stale merge-base committed face)
signings.rationale: Admit the six iam/adapters/pdp-cedar files (BUCK, Cargo.toml, cedar/platform-templates.cedar, cedar/platform.cedarschema, src/lib.rs, tests/cedar_pdp_conformance.rs) as unjustified. This is PRE-EXISTING debt unrelated to the cloud/cloud-ci -> ci/facade keystone move: iam/adapters/pdp-cedar is byte-identical between the merge-base (origin/dev@63905a1a6) and this branch (git diff = empty; the crate was rehomed in the already-merged PR #1184, not by this move). The files are reachable via cargo-members but ADR-0559 references only the crate DIR (iam/adapters/pdp-cedar), not the exact files, so a fresh producer run marks them unjustified. They read as ratchet GROWTH only because the merge-base COMMITTED gate-baseline face is stale (it classifies the dir as justified) — a stale-face false positive, not new debt from this PR. Same admitted-pre-existing class as the registry/stores/*.json and docs/standards/*.md entries. Firewall predicates byte-UNCHANGED. Founder ratification required; the durable fix is exact-path justification in ADR-0559 (a separate iam-scope PR) after which this entry is removed.
signings.adr: ADR-0559 (cloud-iam Cedar PDP commissioning); pre-existing, out-of-scope for the ci keystone move
